name: @ecommerce/web
description: Workspace root for the web clients. Each app is fully self-contained.
//: Workspaces exist here ONLY so one `npm install` covers every app and scripts can run across them. There are deliberately NO cross-package dependencies: nothing in react-store imports from angular-store or from a shared package, and vice versa. Each app owns its own permissions, auth, formatting, API client and design tokens. See docs/adr/0018-self-contained-frontends.md.
